gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the big home-backup stations it ranked use about 36–85 W just to keep the AC inverter switched on. Over an 8-hour night that is 290–680 Wh, as much as or more than the CPAP's own 40 W, so the AC-outlet 'nights per charge' figures on those pages are overstated by about 1.6–2.6×. The Jackery Explorer 5000 Plus's 12 V car port measured 0 Wh idle over 12 hours, and ResMed's AirSense 11 DC/DC converter is made to take 12 V from exactly that kind of port.
standout_why: The two cited ranking pages are RidgeWatt /best/cpap/ and powerstations.reviews /for/cpap. Both calculate capacity × 0.85 ÷ CPAP watts, and neither gives an inverter idle figure. RidgeWatt says only that a maker's DC cable 'lasts longer'. powerstations.reviews says a 12 V port 'depends on your machine's DC cable' and warns about EcoFlow's low-load auto-off. BuyerSheet's DELTA Pro Ultra vs 5000 Plus page lists no idle draw and no 12 V port. The second ChatGPT answer warns that inverters 'can consume significant power' but gives no number, and it still ranks by capacity alone. None of these pages has measured idle watts or the DC-port result.
decides: The pick changes from 'biggest Wh wins' to 'biggest Wh you can draw without the inverter running, or the lowest inverter idle'. Example at ChatGPT's own 40 W CPAP load over 8 hours: on AC, the Jackery 5000 Plus drops from the 13 nights ChatGPT showed to about 6.4 nights (5,040 ÷ (98 W × 8)). The DELTA Pro Ultra drops from 16 to about 8.3 nights (6,144 ÷ (92 W × 8)). The DELTA Pro Ultra X drops from 32 to about 20 nights (12,288 ÷ (76 W × 8)) and stays first on AC. Run through its 12 V port and ResMed's 39231 converter, the 5000 Plus has a ceiling of about 15.7 nights (5,040 ÷ 320 Wh), before converter losses no one has published. That beats the larger DELTA Pro Ultra on AC. The DELTA Pro Ultra X has no AC-free route: The Solar Lab lists AC outlets only. For our camping page, this supports the existing approach of running the CPAP on a regulated 12 V car port with ResMed's DC converter.
